name: Barbarian audit: No Survivors spell modifier reaches its target spells (#1347)
contract: Audit report #1347 asked for a script for a passive whose effects are native spell-mod auras (107 flat, 108 percent). The effect BasePoints and EffectSpellClassMask in Spell.dbc name the spell-mod operation, amount and affected Barbarian spells; Player::ApplySpellMod, which the spell_modifier metric calls, must deliver base+flat or base*(100+pct)/100. Expected values are computed from the DBC amount, not from the implementation.

steps.label: before: 560881 has no modifier for op 1
805864 op 1 flat +5000 reaches 560881 (mask selects 2 Barbarian spell(s))
